Thanks @pcbeingused333 - this LGTM.

One non-blocking nit: CloudWatch publishing is still a synchronous call per event inside the event loop (also written in the TODO above `publishDataToCloudwatch`). With a persistent failure (like a missing `logs:CreateLogStream` permission) each event now makes a failing `CreateLogStream` call, which slows event processing and logs an error per event. This issue isn't new to the PR but would be good to track as its own issue.
